ab: During the day, Shonisaurus gains +40% acceleration, allowing it to build speed more quickly when moving.
Eats only fish. Has a low food drain. A streamlined diet enhances agility, granting a 3% bonus to turn rate.

Reduces incoming damage for all group members by 3% and boosts health regeneration by 30% within a 60-meter radius for 1 minute. Can stack up to 2 times which doubles the effect. Only works when grouped.

Performs a powerful barrel roll that strikes multiple times, dealing light damage per hit. Repeated impacts can stack into high total damage. The sheer force of the attack disrupts the target's movement, reducing their acceleration for 6 seconds.
Eats meat and fish. Has a moderate food drain. Shonisaurus benefits from a protein-rich diet, gaining a 3% damage bonus.
A lunge that propels the Shonisaurus to its maximum speed, dealing damage, allowing it to close distance or escape with sudden force. Deals 2 seconds of fracture.

Shonisaurus is naturally adapted to operate during daylight, benefiting from improved coordination and visual clarity in sunlit waters. During day, it gains bonuses of 5% armor, 10% stamina regen and swim speed.
Upon activating combat timer, Shonisaurus gains 30% extra stamina to slowly chase down its prey.
Take 25% reduced damage from hits to your head, neck, and chest.
Gain 10% increased attack damage when not in a group.
Tail, lunge, and barrel roll attacks inflict increased knockback, with the strongest effect on smaller creatures. This ability also increases fracture of Dash.
For strong, swift swimming, allows speed increase by 5%

Shonisaurus snaps three times in quick succession, dealing low damage per bite but high total DPS if all land. Each hit drains stamina of its target, pressuring foes through sheer ferocity. Stamina-efficient and quick to recover, Ravenous Strike can stagger smaller prey, but repeated use can still tax Shoni’s endurance. [Perfect for drowning land creatures crossing rivers]

This attack delivers a swift, shearing bite designed to rip and mutilate with precision. As the Shonisaurus bites its prey upward, it tears into the target, reducing its swimming speed by 20% for 20 seconds. This debilitation allows the slow but relentless Shonisaurus to keep pace and continue its assault, punishing fast swimmers who fail to stay alert.
Four large, strong flippers provides powerful propulsion and steering, granting 5% speed and 10% acceleration
An attack that causes damage and high knockback.
For dexterious, sustained swimming, allows turn increase by 5%

The broad, sturdy frame of the Shonisaurus makes it difficult for predators to bite down effectively. With its expansive surface area, the Shonisaurus gains a 35% resistance to bleeding and bone-breaking attacks.
